article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article40Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
By the payee against the drawer of a bill of exchange, which has been dishonoured bynon-acceptance.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the refusal to accept.
